title: hoshidicts ar test dictionary
author: hoshidicts
description: A tiny Arabic dictionary for languages/ar/tests/lookup.tsv, written for the pack. Like wiktionary-to-yomitan, it gives verbs and nouns the rules v and n, leaves adjectives, names and particles without rules, and has form-of rows ([lemma, [rules]]) for some inflected forms, among them inflected adjectives (كبيرة), which the rules do not reach in such a dictionary.
